name: rl-streamdeck
author: kvcperkrol
description: Rocket League HUD + shortcuts for Elgato Stream Deck (15-key)

scripts.build: npm run manifest && npm run assets && npm run profile && npm run bundle
scripts.pack: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && streamdeck pack mov.remake.rlhud.sdPlugin --output dist --force && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('dist/mov.remake.rlhud.streamDeckPlugin','dist/Rocket-League-HUD.streamDeckPlugin')"
